precise_shared_proposal.basis: related evidence IDs are accumulated but facts.push retains only the primary physical_root_key/source_ts/observed_ts. Exact two new printed receipts demonstrate the trace gap.
precise_shared_proposal.change: Retain component-origin receipts from ORIGINAL evidence rows before merging: evidence_id/block/provider/upstream/market/dedup-root/window/source_ts/observed_ts. Preserve own clocks/windows and existing text/score; do not infer missing fields from rendered projection.
acceptance_for_coordinator: Controlled primaryHTX+Bitget and primaryHTX+OKX merges retain both native roots/own clocks, cross-windowN05 origin remains distinct.
Existing same-venue two-market identity remains one upstream; no double-counting HTTP5=3+2 or new score/strategy effect.
Unknown/missing component origin stays unknown, never filled from timestamps/names alone.
Existing output text/form and delivered payload must stay byte-exact unless a separately reviewed provenance-only artifact changes.

other_limits: N05manual context is printed but its decision use is not proven; N10/N12neutral assessment and N15score receipts are different use types.
N15CoinGecko/CoinPaprika are aggregators with overlapping possible venues; NEARlayer1 andAI cohorts are different. No independent market consensus inferred.
Native LIQdiagnostics are not the fullLIQ/provider billing ledger; skippedGtrade route retains actual1HTTP and Orderly/models are separate.
USDC/USD quotes and legacy notional_usdt aliases are not exactUSDT conversion.32zones are not32sources or fullmarket coverage.
Current60second role-clock tolerance retained; small event/receipt skew is not a proven defect without transport originals.
